originalTitle: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink

content: With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm is looking to data centers to help boost its bottom line. During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier this year. The company expects that portion of its business to grow quickly, forecasting around $650 million in data center revenue during the first quarter of 2027. But it anticipates that will reach $5 billion by the end of 2027 and $15 billion by 2029. Considering the company’s total revenue for 2026 was $10.4 billion, that would constitute a significant share of its earnings. It confirmed during the call that it expects data centers to eventually account for around 30 percent of its business. That’s not quite as ambitious as AMD, which says that it expects over 80 percent of its revenue will eventually come from data centers. But it suggests there’s plenty of demand that needs to be filled and enough AI money to go around.
chineseTitle: 随着智能手机销量下滑，高通在数据中心上下了重注
chineseSummary: 与 2025 年相比，智能手机销量下降了约 20%，高通正在寻求数据中心来帮助提高其利润。在 2026 年第四季度财报电话会议上，该公司制定了计划，通过与亚马逊和 Meta 等公司的合作，在人工智能数据中心业务中引起轰动 [...]
chineseContent: 与 2025 年相比，智能手机销量下降了约 20%，高通正在寻求数据中心来帮助提高其利润。在 2026 年第四季度财报电话会议上，该公司制定了通过与今年早些时候宣布的亚马逊和 Meta 等公司合作，在人工智能数据中心业务引起轰动的计划。该公司预计这部分业务将​​快速增长，预计 2027 年第一季度数据中心收入约为 6.5 亿美元。但预计到 2027 年底将达到 50 亿美元，到 2029 年将达到 150 亿美元。考虑到该公司 2026 年的总收入为 104 亿美元，这将占其收益的很大一部分。该公司在电话会议中确认，预计数据中心最终将占其业务的 30% 左右。这并不像 AMD 那样雄心勃勃，AMD 表示预计 80% 以上的收入最终将来自数据中心。但这表明有大量的需求需要满足，并且有足够的人工智能资金可以使用。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
